server.name: io.github.ObscuritySRL/umbriel
server.description: See and drive a whole Windows machine from Bun — apps, input, screen, OCR, registry, OS — via MCP.

environmentVariables.description: Capability profile: 'readonly' (inspect/read only), 'safe' (read + input + window — default), or 'full' (also os + fs tools).
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to allow the 'os' tools (launch_app/run_program/open_path, kill_process, manage_process, control_service, set_env, registry_get/registry_list/registry_set) AND the 'fs' tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) regardless of profile.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_OS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to additionally allow on top of the profile.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_ALLOW

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to deny, overriding the profile and UMBRIEL_ALLOW.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_DENY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'never' to forbid the real-cursor fallback entirely (strictly cursor-free). By default clicks/drags are cursor-free but fall back to the real hardware cursor when no cursor-free path exists.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_CURSOR

environmentVariables.description: Sandbox root directory that the fs-category file tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) are confined to when fs tools are enabled; open_path's path argument is honored too.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_FS_ROOT

environmentVariables.description: File path to journal every mutating tool call as JSON Lines (tool, category, masked args, ok, observation); secret-bearing args and values are redacted. Unset = no trace.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_TRACE

environmentVariables.description: Controls the default-on stderr audit of mutating tool calls. 'off' is the explicit opt-out (reported at startup); 'verbose' also audits reads.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_AUDIT

environmentVariables.description: Credential masking (default on). 'off' opts out; a regex value overrides the built-in secret shapes masked in clipboard/env/registry reads and the trace journal.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_REDACT

To learn more, please visit our MCP documentation.

environmentVariables.description: Mode A — real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install — it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.

environmentVariables.description: Mode B — local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard → Agent tab → Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet — your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.

environmentVariables.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move — every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.

server.name: io.github.piprail/mcp
server.description: Budget-bound x402 payment wallet for AI agents — pays HTTP 402 URLs, capped locally. No backend.
server.title: PipRail

environmentVariables.description: Your wallet's private key/seed for the chosen chain. Optional: omit it to run read-only (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); set it to let the agent pay. Stays on your machine; the spend policy caps every payment.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Chain to pay on (default: base).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAIN

environmentVariables.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. Give each its own PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_KEY (+ optional PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL). The agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for — the first listed that can settle — under one shared budget.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAINS

environmentVariables.description: Max spend per single payment, in token units (default: 0.10).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL

environmentVariables.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW

environmentVariables.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION

environmentVariables.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES

agent_routing.evidence_first_pass: Use /v1/intelligence/precomputed/query first for broad Japanese public-program questions; use /v1/evidence/packets/query when source fields, known_gaps, records, or context estimates are needed.
agent_routing.japanese_company_first_hop: Use createCompanyPublicBaseline before general web search for Japanese company folders, client notes, counterparty checks, audit/DD prep, sales/account prep, and public opportunity/risk review.
agent_routing.paid_activation_rule: Use previewCost before broad paid runs; rerun with X-API-Key after the anonymous daily trial.

pricing.billing_model: metered per billable unit, no monthly minimum

do_not_recommend_when: Do not use for general writing, brainstorming, translation, or tasks outside Japanese public records.
Do not use when the user needs final professional judgment or application drafting by a qualified professional.
Do not use when a short answer from existing model knowledge is enough and no source-linked evidence is needed.
safe_when: Use for Japanese subsidies, loans, tax measures, certifications, bids, laws, enforcement cases, invoice registrants, or public-program eligibility when source-linked evidence is needed.
Use when the answer should preserve source_url, fetched_at, provenance, known_gaps, compatibility rules, or citation verification.
Use as retrieval and evidence support, not as final legal, tax, grant-application, or professional advice.

environmentVariables.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX

environmentVariables.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP

environmentVariables.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS

environmentVariables.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS

environmentVariables.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT
